headCoach.name: Dave Rennie
headCoach.detail: Appointed All Blacks head coach on 4 March 2026, through to the 2027 Rugby World Cup. Scott Robertson had departed in January 2026.

captain.summary: Ardie Savea was named captain for Dave Rennie's first squad and captained the side through the Soweto Test. He dislocated a shoulder in that match. Codie Taylor captained the Baltimore Test, his first Test as captain. A captain for the Bledisloe Tests had not been named in the sources checked on 28 Sep 2026.

southAfrica.title: South Africa
facts: The four-Test series is finished. South Africa won it 3–1. Nothing in this series is live.

New Zealand won the first Test 33–16 at Emirates Airline Park on 22 August (ESPN calls that ground Ellis Park, Johannesburg), then lost 26–33 at Cape Town Stadium on 29 August (ESPN says DHL Stadium, Cape Town), 24–29 at First National Bank Stadium on 5 September (ESPN says FNB Stadium, Johannesburg), and 28–43 at M&T Bank Stadium in Baltimore on 12 September. The scores are the same on Rugby Database and ESPN.
Codie Taylor captained the Baltimore Test. Ardie Savea had already gone home with a dislocated shoulder.

australia.title: Australia
australia.meta: Bledisloe Cup · still to be played · no prediction
facts: Saturday 10 October, Eden Park, Auckland, 7.10pm New Zealand time. Saturday 17 October, Accor Stadium, Sydney.
The Sydney kick-off is not verified. allblacks.com lists 6.00pm New Zealand time. The Accor Stadium event page lists 3.45pm local.
allblacks.com says New Zealand have held the Bledisloe Cup since 2003.
Australia beat South Africa 42–38 in Perth on 27 September 2026.

On the All Blacks site, Dave Rennie said Ardie Savea and Luke Jacobson will be out of the Bledisloe squad he is planning. The same page, dated as at 21 September, says Savea needs shoulder surgery and that a return date follows the operation. RNZ later reported that New Zealand Rugby confirmed the surgery.

allblacks.com reported that Wallabies flyhalf Carter Gordon fractured his leg and is expected to miss the series, and that Jordan Petaia has been called into the wider Wallabies squad. Cheslin Kolbe plays for South Africa. He is not in this fixture.
No win percentage is shown. There is no prediction model on this page.

gamePlan.heading: All Blacks game plan (public reporting)
gamePlan.label: Compiled from public reporting on 28 Sep 2026. This is not AI analysis, and it is not an internal All Blacks document.

bullets.text: The All Blacks site, reviewing the South Africa series, said the attack can trouble the Springboks, but that New Zealand too often needed long passages of possession to score. ESPN's Liam Napier wrote on 20 Sep 2026 that Dave Rennie and Mike Blair have aimed the attack at pace and at space out wide, and he reported 35 tries in seven Tests. The score sheets in this file also add up to 35 tries.

After the Baltimore loss, Rennie said the high ball put the side under more heat and that they could not take a lot of those balls. The All Blacks site listed collection of contested kicks as a review area. ESPN reported that the high ball is still a problem and gave Will Jordan a series-high 24 turnovers. That turnover figure is ESPN's count. It is not an official All Blacks statistic re-counted here.

Rennie said the scrum and lineout in the Baltimore Test were excellent. Across the series, ESPN reported 14 scrum penalties conceded, including one penalty try, and a lineout at 86 percent after eight lost throws. Those series figures are ESPN's. The All Blacks site named set-piece consistency as a review area. The penalty try in the score sheets is the Soweto one, awarded to South Africa.

Rennie said needless penalties have to come out of the game, and he called that sort of penalty dumb. The All Blacks site said South Africa were more ruthless after penalties and turnovers. ESPN wrote that smaller wingers stationed in midfield, Leroy Carter and Josh Moorby, were pushed off the ball and that this led to three tries.

Rennie said he was happy with Beauden Barrett off the bench in Baltimore, and that the side has cover at first-five and fullback in Richie Mo'unga, Ruben Love, Damian McKenzie and Beauden Barrett. He also praised Kyle Preston's speed to the breakdown. He said the Bledisloe group would be a squad of 34, with Luke Jacobson and Ardie Savea out, and with Scott Barrett and Leicester Fainga'anuku among those expected back.

The side won its first four Tests, including 33–16 at Ellis Park, then lost the next three. South Africa won the series 3–1. Rennie said the tour was meant to teach them about their game model, that the Baltimore result hurts, and that he still feels they are tracking in the right direction while needing to be better against a side like the Springboks.

bullets.topic: What Rennie said he wanted, before July
bullets.text: Before the July Tests, Rennie told Sky Sport NZ, as reported by SABC Sport, that he treats counter-attack as a set piece because so much possession arrives from kicks, and that he wanted more tries from counter-attack and turnover ball than the year before. The 2025 split he mentioned is his recollection. It is not re-counted here.

A captain for the October and November Tests. Codie Taylor captained Baltimore. No Bledisloe captain was named in the sources checked.
Ardie Savea's return date. The All Blacks injury list of 21 September says it follows surgery. RNZ reported a lengthy layoff. The date is not verified.
ESPN's series counts from Liam Napier's review: 14 scrum penalties, a lineout at 86 percent, eight lost lineouts, and 24 high-ball turnovers for Will Jordan. Reported, not re-counted here.
How long Australia's unbeaten run is. BBC and RNZ reported the 42–38 win in Perth. They do not agree on five or six matches, so no streak length is shown.
Nations Championship Finals Weekend, 27–29 November in London. The opponent is not known, so it is not a fixture.
